capabilities.name: configured real model Provider availability
evidence: isolated audit intentionally removed Provider credentials

issues.userVisibleImpact: Full-profile archive creation can write outside the Workspace with ../ paths and no permission checkpoint.
issues.minimalReproduction: Compress an isolated Workspace fixture to ../escape.gz; repeat for tar_create and zip_create.
issues.expected: All source and destination paths must use the canonical Workspace/permission resolver before I/O.
issues.actual: gzip_compress, tar_create and zip_create created sibling files outside the isolated Workspace.
issues.requiredRedTest: Traversal, absolute path, symlink and deny/cancel tests must prove zero archive writes outside Workspace.

issues.userVisibleImpact: Archive decompression lacks aggregate byte, member and time budgets.
issues.minimalReproduction: Expand a high-ratio archive fixture in an isolated Workspace.
issues.expected: Archive extraction must stop at documented byte, member and time budgets before allocating or writing unbounded output.
issues.actual: The HTTP response paths are bounded; archive extraction still lacks an aggregate decompression budget.
issues.requiredRedTest: Archive bomb fixtures must stop at documented byte, member and time budgets.

issues.userVisibleImpact: A read-only Tool is classified as non-read-only/non-concurrency-safe, reducing truthful scheduling metadata.
issues.expected: Read-only navigation tools should expose read-only and concurrency-safe metadata.
issues.actual: file_line_count is absent from the central read-only name set and has no explicit metadata.
issues.requiredRedTest: Registry metadata contract must enumerate every Tool's read/write, destructive and concurrency properties.

issues.userVisibleImpact: Several full-profile utility validators accept a missing schema-required field as an empty value.
issues.minimalReproduction: Call each validator with an empty object for base64_encode, hash, line_count, text_dedupe, text_join, text_sort and url_encode.
issues.expected: A field declared required in the Tool schema must be rejected when omitted.
issues.actual: All seven validators accept the empty object, so runtime behavior diverges from the model-visible schema.
issues.requiredRedTest: Table-driven schema/validator conformance must reject every omitted required field and wrong scalar type.

issues.userVisibleImpact: Ordinary user facts are not persisted/retrievable across Sessions.
issues.minimalReproduction: Submit the isolated phrase 小花是我唯一的好朋友。 through the current Memory write path, then search 小花.
issues.expected: A declared conversational fact intake path should create an approved/reviewable durable fact with scope and provenance.
issues.actual: No fact entry or search hit was produced; the separate one-off web_search failure was correctly suppressed as non-recurrent.
issues.requiredRedTest: Two isolated Sessions must prove the exact ordinary fact is persisted, approved, retrieved and injected.
